# Fingerprint

Generated from [tokens.json](tokens.json) and [README.md](README.md) by the design-systems catalog tool. Do not edit this file: change the tokens through the package's builders, then run `make design-md` at the repository root.

It follows the DESIGN.md spec, version alpha. That format has no themes, no per-value provenance and only px, em and rem units, so this file holds the `light` theme alone with every alias resolved. [tokens.json](tokens.json) is the source of truth: it records where each value was read, and keeps the 0 tokens from these groups that DESIGN.md cannot hold (gradients, shadows, percentages, durations and other non-colour or non-px values).

## Overview

Good for: Device-intelligence marketing: warm gray page, one orange primary button, 56px sticky header, mega menus, Inter labels at 12px.

Captured 2026-11-21, signed out. Dashboard login reached and not entered.. Themes: light.

Public site of Fingerprint (fingerprint.com), captured 2026-11-21, signed out. Desktop 1440 by 900 and phone 390 by 844. One light theme on the marketing site. The dashboard login was reached and not entered.

## Do's and Don'ts

- Do take values from [tokens.json](tokens.json) when you need another theme, a value's source, or a token this file leaves out.
- Do read [README.md](README.md) before relying on a value; it says what is known to be wrong.
- Don't read colours off the screenshots; they are 256-colour PNGs.
- Don't copy the product's logo, icons, illustrations or brand colours into something that ships. Borrow structure and proportions.
- Don't edit this file; it is regenerated from the tokens.

### What to distrust (from README.md)

The marketing site is light only. Docs has a dark-mode toggle that was not captured as a token set. Homepage frames that paint a live visitor identifier are not in screenshots/. The signed-in app, onboarding, and form validation were not captured. Sitemap leaves (599 blog posts, 150 bot pages, 101 explorer entries, 27 case studies) share hub chrome and were not each photographed.

### Do and don't (from README.md)

- **Keep the orange for the one primary action.** Get Started is `#f35820` on a warm gray page. See [pricing](screenshots/desktop-pricing.png).
- **Open Product, Use Cases, and Resources as panels, not pages.** See [Product menu](screenshots/desktop-menu-product.png).
- **Stop at the login dialog.** Google, GitHub, and Microsoft sit above email. See [login wall](screenshots/desktop-login-wall.png).
- **Do not invent a dark marketing theme.** The public site paints one light surface.
- **Do not submit the newsletter or contact form** as part of using this reference.
